sources.title: Graphiti temporal knowledge graph framework
sources.copyright_owner_or_originator: Zep AI, Inc. and Graphiti contributors
sources.reuse_basis: Capability behavior was read from the public Apache-2.0 source tree and restated in original words for comparison purposes. No source code, documentation prose, schema text, or prompt content is reproduced in this repository.
sources.material_reused: None. The conformance mapping describes observed capabilities and their absence; it copies no substrate text or code.
sources.provenance_note: Examined at graphiti-core version 0.29.3, main tree 401c59a65bdeb22a44136901ff30231e6998a7fe. Mapping is independent synthesis for substrate evaluation under the runtime evidence program. Registered as an external comparator and candidate substrate, not as an implementation owner or doctrine source.
sources.limitations: Documentation-verified only; no runtime execution has occurred, so no row constitutes runtime evidence. The substrate's documentation site and source tree disagree in at least two observed places; the mapping follows the source tree. Five open questions remain that require an executed probe.

sources.title: DashClaw agent governance runtime
sources.reuse_basis: Repository MIT license verified. Agent Memory independently summarizes the inspected governance architecture and uses DashClaw as a comparator/interoperability target; no DashClaw implementation or distinctive documentation expression is copied.
sources.material_reused: None. Intercept/decision/approval/enforcement/evidence boundaries are described independently for architecture comparison and interoperability planning.
sources.provenance_note: Inspected as an external governance/enforcement peer. DashClaw issue #219 records a public optional-interoperability suggestion; it is not evidence of adoption or formal partnership.
sources.limitations: DashClaw remains authoritative for its own product semantics. Agent Memory must not represent proposed interoperability as shipped DashClaw capability until independently verified.

sources.title: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit

sources.provenance_note: Registered as an enforcement peer and interoperability target, not as the source or owner of Agent Memory semantics. Project names are used descriptively; the AGT charter identifies Agent Governance Toolkit and AGT as Microsoft trademarks.

sources.title: Open Policy Agent
sources.reuse_basis: Repository Apache-2.0 license verified. Agent Memory exercises OPA as a bounded policy comparator and does not import OPA semantics into canonical memory doctrine.

sources.limitations: Comparator success is bounded evidence only; it does not make OPA a required runtime or source of Agent Memory authority.

sources.title: AgentTrust TRACE specification
sources.reuse_basis: Current repository licensing was verified as component-specific rather than flattened to one license: code and current specification material are generally Apache-2.0, while non-specification documentation is CC BY 4.0 and legacy v0.1 material retains its documented treatment. Agent Memory currently uses independent synthesis and interoperability comparison rather than copying TRACE expression.
sources.provenance_note: Registered because TRACE/cMCP evidence surfaces are named and exercised by the reference evidence program. Split licensing is recorded explicitly rather than represented as a single SPDX identifier.
sources.limitations: Verify the exact TRACE file/version license before any direct reuse. Linking, comparison, and independent synthesis do not transfer TRACE rights into Agent Memory's Apache-2.0 license.
